data.title: Three Premier League talking points
data.description: LONDON - Manchester City gave a defiant response after being found guilty of breaching the Premier League's financial rules as the leaders romped to victory at Liverpool.

data.title: Man City shrug off uncertain future to beat 10-man Liverpool
data.description: LIVERPOOL - Manchester City shrugged off the threat of swingeing sanctions to beat 10-man Liverpool 3-0 in their first game since being found guilty on more than 100 charges of breaking Premier League financial rules.

data.title: Streets to avoid during IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok
data.description: The government has advised motorists to avoid some Bangkok streets that will be used for the 2026 Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank Group from Oct 12-18.

data.title: Second Thai suspect arrested after abducted Chinese rescued
data.description: Police have arrested a second Thai man suspected of taking abducted Chinese job seekers to the Thai-Myanmar border, after three Chinese captives were rescued and a Thai suspect apprehended last month.

data.title: South Korea completes Arctic shipping route trial
data.description: SEOUL - A South Korean container ship returned on Sunday from a trial voyage through the Arctic, testing an alternative route opened by melting sea ice as conflict in the Middle East disrupts global shipping.

data.title: Flooding in 21 provinces, rain moving South
data.description: Flooding persists in parts of 21 provinces, mostly on the Central Plain, as the northern runoff surge arrives, adding to residual rainfall, the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation reported on Sunday.

data.title: Mu Koh Similan National Park reopens Oct 15
data.description: Mu Koh Similan National Park in Phang Nga province will reopen to visitors on Oct 15 for the 2026-27 tourist season.

data.title: India releases 'cockroach' leaders as movement calls for more protests
data.description: NEW DELHI - The leaders of India's youth-led online "cockroach" movement were released on Sunday, their lawyer said, a day after they were detained to thwart a major protest against the election commissioner.

data.title: Japanese brewer hopes 'wobbly' beer glass will spur responsible drinking
data.description: A craft beer producer in central Japan is hoping that its U-shaped "wobbly" glass will encourage people to drink water along with their beer, in a bid to prevent excessive alcohol consumption and dehydration.

data.title: Indian court releases 'cockroach' movement leaders from detention
data.description: NEW DELHI - The founder of India's youth-led online "cockroach" movement and two other leaders were released on Sunday, their lawyer said, a day after they were detained to thwart a major protest against the election commissioner.

data.title: Thailand reports no confirmed plague outbreak in Russia’s Irkutsk
data.description: Tests on contacts detected COVID-19 and rhinovirus but no plague, while checks found no errors in work involving pathogens at an Irkutsk research institute.

data.title: Bangkok police name 5 areas to avoid on October 12–18
data.description: Bangkok government staff will work from home on October 12, 14 and 15, with a special holiday on October 16 to ease IMF–World Bank meeting traffic.

data.title: Police arrest women supplying laughing gas to Bangkok’s Khao San Road
data.description: Police have arrested two women in Bangkok who allegedly supplied balloons of laughing gas to customers on Khao San Road in Bangkok.

data.title: Hong Kong police smash alleged Thai prostitution ring, seize B55m cash
data.description: Hong Kong police have dismantled a local syndicate allegedly running a vice ring involving Thai women, seizing HK$13 million in cash (55 million baht) and freezing HK$5 million in suspected crime proceeds.

data.title: Ambulance fire in Phuket, no injuries
data.description: PHUKET - A fire damaged an ambulance parked at a hospital in Muang district on Sunday morning.

data.title: Russian Yandex data centre operations disrupted after drone strike
data.description: MOSCOW - A drone attack damaged a Russian Yandex data centre east of the capital and disrupted operations at the facility, the technology giant said Sunday.

data.title: Whalefall director hopes survival story inspires awe of whales
data.description: Director Brian Duffield describes his new survival thriller Whalefall, in which a teenager is swallowed by a sperm whale, as "the opposite of Jaws".

data.title: All Blacks crush Aussies to retain Bledisloe Cup
data.description: AUCKLAND: Australia's hopes of wresting back the Bledisloe Cup ‌for the first time in a generation were crushed in familiar fashion in a comprehensive 50-19 loss to New Zealand at Auckland's Eden Park yesterday.

data.title: Premier League in 'limbo'                         as Man City case drags on
data.description: LONDON: Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola said the lack of clarity over Manchester City's future after the club was found guilty of multiple breaches of financial rules was causing uncertainty throughout the Premier League.

data.title: At least 12 killed, 309 injured in attack on airport in Riyadh
data.description: At ⁠least ​12 ​people ‌were killed ​and 309 others ⁠were ‌injured in a ⁠Saturday attack on King Khalid International ​airport in ​Riyadh, ‌the Saudi ​Civil ⁠Aviation authority ⁠said on Sunday.

data.title: US lifts sanctions on daughter of Myanmar military-linked businessman
data.description: WASHINGTON - The United States lifted on Friday sanctions ‌on the daughter of a Myanmar businessman accused of supporting the country's military, according to the US Treasury Department's website, after she filed a suit seeking removal from the blacklist.
